products.name: Sea Moss Gel
products.description: Fresh, natural and nourishing sea moss gel made for everyday wellness.

details.usage: Start with 1 tablespoon per day and increase to 2 tablespoons if it works well for you. Enjoy directly from the spoon or mix into smoothies, juices, porridge, tea, soups, sauces, or other foods and drinks.
details.storage: Keep refrigerated after receiving. Always use a clean spoon when serving.
